chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Yūsuf ibn ʿAqīl, from Muḥammad ibn Qays, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام gave judgment regarding a mukātabah woman who committed zina. He said: 'It is to be considered how much of her mukātabah she has paid; for that portion, upon her is the hadd of a free woman, and for what she has not yet completed, upon that is the hadd of a slave woman.' And he said: 'Regarding a mukātabah woman who committed zina, while three-quarters of her had been emancipated and one-quarter remained, she was flogged three-quarters of the hadd calculated according to the free woman on the basis of one hundred, making that seventy-five lashes; and one-quarter of it calculated according to fifty for the slave woman, twelve and a half lashes; making that eighty-seven and a half lashes. And he refused to stone her and to exile her before her emancipation became fully clear.'
Yūnus ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from ʿĀṣim, from Muḥammad ibn Qays, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, similarly, except that he said:
'The whip is to be taken from its middle and she is to be struck with it; and likewise for less and more.'

key_terms.جَلْدَةً: A lash given as corporal punishment.
key_terms.حَدُّ الْأَمَةِ: The prescribed legal punishment applicable to a slave woman.
key_terms.حَدُّ الْحُرَّةِ: The prescribed legal punishment applicable to a free woman.
key_terms.مُكَاتَبَةٍ: A slave woman under a manumission contract who is earning her freedom through payment.

ai.seo_question: How is the hadd for zina calculated for a mukātabah woman who is partially emancipated?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the hadd punishment of a mukātabah woman who commits zina, proportioning her punishment according to the amount of emancipation she has completed. It also shows judicial precision in calculating the punishment and withholding rajm and exile until her legal status as fully free is established.
